module: Flowgraph node "Auto Star Goals" (category once_instant, tag activity). Automatically creates the Tasklist app's objectives from the mission's active stars: sends the guihook SetTasklistHeader (mission name) then one SetTasklistTask per active star (type goal, id = star key, label from starLabels). Hardcoded input pin "addMissionTitle" (bool).
notes: The addMissionTitle pin is declared but never read: the header is always sent.
A string label becomes {txt, context} with the context taken from the string/number fields of missionTypeData; a function label is called with the mission.
Crashes without an associated activity (self.mgr.activity is nil).

workOnce.desc: Sends SetTasklistHeader then a SetTasklistTask (done/fail false, active true) for each star of careerSetup.starsActive.
